selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq of magnetically isolated circulating NK cells (Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE100), HTSeq raw counts + Cufflinks FPKM (S2.5.p2)
selected.samples: 9 B-cell ALL children in remission + 9 age/sex-matched healthy controls, each sampled before (baseline) and immediately after (peak) one acute cycling session = 36 libraries (ABS.p2, S2.5)
selected.primary_estimand: Difference between ALL-in-remission and control children in the within-subject NK-cell transcriptome response to an acute exercise bout (group x time interaction, paired by child) (S2.6.p2, S3.p3)
planned_contrasts: group x time interaction: (ALL post-pre) - (CON post-pre), paired (S3.p3; paper: 179 genes, 163 negative / 16 positive, p<0.01, Suppl. Table S3)
baseline ALL vs CON (S3.p2; paper: 284 genes, 124 up / 160 down, p<0.01, Suppl. Table S1) - disease contrast, not an exercise effect
within-group post vs pre in ALL (Suppl. Table S6) and in CON (Suppl. Table S7) (S3.p3; counts not stated in the text)
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.38.3 on raw counts, paired design (subject), multifactor design with interaction terms (S2.6.p2)

paper_results.named_genes: IL1B down in ALL post vs pre (log2FC -1.68, p<0.001) but not in CON (-0.18, p=0.59) (S4.p6); TREM1, S100A8/A9/A12 down in ALL only (S4.p4-p5)

selected.pathway_method: QIAGEN IPA canonical pathways, FDR<0.05 (S2.6.p2) - proprietary, not reproducible here

decisions.reason: Methods S2.6.p2 define DESeq2 with paired design + interaction terms and raw p<0.01. Results S3.p2 (baseline 284 DEGs) and S3.p3 (interaction 179 genes) give the counts. The exercise question is the within-subject post-vs-pre change and its group difference.

checks: paper S8.p1 and S2.5.p2 name GSE272928
36 GSMs = 18 children x 2 timepoints, 9 ALL + 9 CON, matches ABS.p2
matrix columns ALL02..ALL12, CONT_51..59 x BASELINE/PEAK match GEO titles

decisions.reason: The series is the paper's deposit (paper S8.p1, Series_pubmed_id 40881686); the only series supplementary file is GSE272928_transformed_RNA_seq_Data.xlsx (csv copy used), 36 sample columns matching the 36 GSM titles.

Matrix column names were renamed by name (prep/rename_columns.py, ALL02_BASELINE -> ALL_02_BASELINE) so that they equal a key derived from the GEO title (<GROUP>_<NN>_<TIME>; title 'ALL03  PEAK' has a double space, handled by \s+). grp/time/subject come from the title; grp agrees with characteristics 'health status' and time with 'time 1/time 2' (BASELINE=time 1, PEAK=time 2) for all 36 samples.

selected.paper_input: DESeq2 on HTSeq raw counts (S2.5.p2, S2.6.p2)

candidates: signed_log_scale (log ratios, M-values, or centered data)

decisions.reason: File is named 'transformed'; values are continuous (no non-zero integers), range -4.38..18.9, all-zero genes stored as exactly 0 and near-zero genes at a shared floor of about -4.375 with tiny between-sample spread - the signature of DESeq2 rlog (rlog returns 0 for all-zero rows and shrinks low-count rows to a common value). sum(2^x) per sample is 2.6e7-2.8e7 with SD 2%, consistent with size-factor-normalized counts on log2 scale. GEO data_processing says the submitter produced raw counts (all_merged.txt) but that file is not deposited (sample supplementary_file_1 = NONE; only the transformed xlsx in the series). Not raw counts, so DESeq2 cannot be run; log2-scale input supports limma.

selected.analysis_type: paired_change (2x2 mixed: group between-subject, time within-subject)
selected.formula: per-subject delta = post - pre; ~ 0 + C(grp) on deltas; baseline: ~ grp on pre samples

decisions.reason: S2.6.p2: paired design + interaction terms. The exercise effect is the within-child post-vs-pre change; the paper's headline exercise result is the group x time interaction (S3.p3). Within-group changes (Suppl. S6/S7) are the paper's own secondary results and the direct 'exercise effect' per group. Baseline ALL vs CON (S3.p2) is a disease (associational) contrast reported by the paper; run as secondary. All 18 children have both timepoints.

covariates.name: sex
covariates.disposition: not included: groups sex-matched (2 girls each, Table 1); paper model has no sex term

covariates.name: age
covariates.disposition: not included: age-matched (Table 1, p=0.51); paper model has no age term

decisions.reason: Each child contributes a baseline and a peak sample: subject is the blocking unit, handled by within-subject post-pre differences (equivalent to subject fixed effects for time and group x time). Group is between-subject; the baseline contrast uses one sample per child so needs no blocking.

selected.method: limma (inmoose lmFit + eBayes) on the deposited rlog log2 matrix
selected.formula: paired change: delta ~ 0 + C(grp) with contrasts; baseline: ~ grp on pre samples

paper_route.method: DESeq2 v1.38.3 on HTSeq raw counts, paired + interaction design
paper_route.reason: raw counts (all_merged.txt) not deposited in GSE272928; only the rlog-transformed matrix is available, and DESeq2 requires integer counts

deviations: limma on rlog values instead of DESeq2 negative-binomial Wald tests on counts
zero-variance genes (all-zero rows) dropped by the executor

decisions.reason: Matrix-method policy: log-scale normalized input -> limma. The deposited values are already log2-scale; no further transform. Paired-change limma on deltas reproduces the paper's paired interaction structure.

selected.deviation_note: paper's raw p<0.01 applied to limma p-values from the deviation route; BH FDR<0.05 kept as a separate audit rule

decisions.reason: S2.6.p2: 'a p-value cut-off of 0.01 was considered statistically significant' with no fold-change rule.

Paired within-child change (post - pre) per gene, one limma model on the 18 deltas with a group mean per arm: the ALL-CON difference is the paper's group x time interaction (S3.p3), and each arm's mean change is its within-group exercise effect (Suppl. S6/S7).
Paper S3.p2 baseline disease comparison (one sample per child); associational, not an exercise effect.
Suitability lists grp_ALL_vs_CON_time-post as analyzable; the paper does not report it. Exploratory, associational.
Per-sex split from the suitability split_plan (paper pooled sexes). Males: 7 ALL + 7 CON children; females (2 per group) are below n=3 per cell and are not analyzed separately.
